title: Bewegend / Klar (ehrlich) / Zuversichtlich
slide_intent: Define a speaking stance so messages can motivate, orient and reassure without relying on visual style alone.
strategic_value: An active, direct and forward-looking voice can support DB’s intended personality across channels.
demonstration: Three expanded text panels define moving, clear/honest and confident communication.
practical_value: Review language for active progress, transparent information and realistic attention to solutions.

content_islands.name: Bewegend
content_islands.spec: Open with active language about movement, development and participation.

content_islands.name: Klar (ehrlich)
content_islands.spec: Use the middle panel for direct, understandable information without empty phrases or evasion.

content_islands.name: Zuversichtlich
content_islands.spec: Close with possibilities, solutions and a forward-looking outlook even amid challenges.

reference_purposes.Intent: Each panel explains the intended human effect: energy and motivation; trust and orientation; courage and hope.
reference_purposes.Application: The panels describe how messages should frame progress, facts and possibilities.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The clear/honest panel rejects unnecessary stock phrases and evasive wording.

ingredient.name: Brand voice
ingredient.role: Help people understand DB’s position and participate in progress.
ingredient.application: Use active, transparent and forward-looking language; avoid empty phrases and evasion.
ingredient.scope: The three traits guide communication tone; they do not justify omitting problems or setbacks, which the transparency examples explicitly include.
